📢 FIRST GENERAL BODY MEETING OF THE SEMESTER!

Join us for our Fall Kickoff GBM! Learn about upcoming legislation, student advocacy committees, and open executive board seats.

⏰ Time: 7:30 PM - 9:00 PM
📍 Location: Student Activities Center (SAC) Multipurpose Room

Free pizza will be served! RSVP via link in bio: https://forms.gle/rutgersGBM2026
Happy Friday Scarlet Knights! Don't forget to register to vote before the deadline. Have a wonderful weekend!
